newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary FinMin accepts tax office head resignation.
newsitem.headline: Hungary FinMin accepts tax office head resignation.

text.p: Hungary's Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy had accepted the resignation of Zoltan Pitti, the president of the tax office, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
"(Pitti) said that unjust attacks against him motivated his resignation," the ministry's statement said.
Pitti's request "met with the intentions of the Finance Minister," the statement added.

Pitti will leave his post on December 31. He was unavailable for comment and the tax office's press department said Pitti does not want to make public his resignation letter or give any further information than contained in the Finance Ministry's statement.
